draftNote: 2 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Cuban Noobster (midlane→carry), Willy Guggenheim (offlane→jungle).

coaching.headline: A 3-stack run off the map — towers 1–9, objectives 4–25. The two solo lanes held even but the team got sieged out by 27 minutes.
coaching.team: The trio (Willy/Cuban/Xeebs) plus two randoms; the map collapsed (1 tower to 9). Four of five lanes read favored — this was a fights-and-map loss, not a draft one: the decisive fights were lost while an ahead teammate stayed in lane (flagged at 11, 12.7, 13.9, 15.6, 17.8 and 22.7), and Xeebs' Crunch — unfavored in the jungle — took his 9 deaths in those short-handed fights, none of them solo catches.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Stop forcing fights when behind on towers — the macro flags an ahead teammate absent at 11, 12.7, 13.9, 15.6, 17.8 and 22.7. Play for vision and a single Fangtooth pick instead of feeding the siege.

perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Crunch jungle, 1/9 into a read 'theirs all game' — none of the nine deaths were solo catches; they came in team fights the macro flags as short-handed starts, with Xeebs pinned at 11 while ahead lanes stayed home. The film also flags no armor into a 3-physical comp.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: The Fey mid (2/5) into a favored Wraith (57.2%) — Cuban Noobster had the edge on paper and went even; the loss was the map, not the lane.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Aurora offlane, 3/4/1 into a lane read favored — but Bayle ran it to 7/1, and the macro flags Willy Guggenheim ahead-and-absent at 11, 12.7 and 13.9 while short-handed fights were lost; a won read has to become rotations.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Adele. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
ourKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
ourKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
ourKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
ourKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

ourKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
ourKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
ourKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
ourKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
ourKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
ourKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
ourKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Vortex Grenade → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate ult
enemyKits.winCondition: reposition with Rocket Dash and unload Ventilate from safety
enemyKits.passive: abilities grant AS + a triple-shot next basic
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to create his free-fire window
enemyKits.playAgainst: he's mobile but squishy — CC through the dash, then burst

enemyKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 2 times in 27 minutes, fewer deaths than about 81% of TwinBlast carry players this patch. The build added healing off damage.
Ventilate at rank 2: 105s base, about 74.5s by the end (29% shorter) from 41 ability haste: Malady 8, Solaris 10, The Perforator 15, Ortus 8.
14 takedowns (10 kills, 4 assists) fed: Malady (Demise), Ortus (Limit Breaker).
TwinBlast dealt 22,199 hero damage, 23% of their team's, with +207 physical power from items.

Penetration: Malady 11, Deathstalker 10, The Perforator 8, Ortus 5, The Perforator ignores 30%; against Drongo (level 13: about 80 physical armor, 22 after penetration; took 13,286 physical damage from heroes, 67% of all hero damage they took) and Crunch (level 13: about 101 physical armor, 37 after penetration; took 13,937 physical damage from heroes, 56% of all hero damage they took) that is about 48% and 47% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).

loadout.name: Ferocity
loadout.text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.
loadout.plain: Attack speed keeps rising each second Bayle stays in a hero fight, so long fights favor Bayle more as they go. Weak in quick skirmishes.

loadout.name: Judgement
loadout.text: Thunder Cleaver:  Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.
loadout.plain: Activate mid-fight to hit everyone around him and heal on each hero hit; the first heals fully, the rest at 50%. Use after Skull Crusher lands him in the crowd.

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 27 minutes, fewer deaths than about 90% of Bayle offlane players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Kingslayer at rank 3: 115s base, about 95.8s by the end (17% shorter) from 20 ability haste: Fist Of Razuul 20.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Bayle dealt 25,518 hero damage, 26% of their team's, with +32 physical power from items.
Rapture (item): While within 475u of an Enemy Unit: Your Basic Attacks deal 20 (+2.5%)(+15%) Damage On-Hit to them.
Fist Of Razuul (item): When dealing or receiving damage: For the next 3s, generate a stack each second. Upon reaching 4 stacks, Empower your next Basic Attack.
Fist Of Razuul (item): Deal 25% increased damage to Minions.
Cursed Scroll (item): On Basic Attack: Deal 20 (+3.5%) Damage to yourself and the Enemy Target. This damage cannot hurt you below 35% Health.
Judgement (crest): Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
Alpha's Court (Eternal minor): Deal 6% bonus damage when no allied hero is within 800 units.

Sustain: 11% omnivamp; Fist Of Razuul: When dealing or receiving damage: For the next 3s, generate a stack each second. Upon reaching 4 stacks, Empower your next Basic Attack.; Judgement: Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.; 8,622 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1350 health, +40 physical armor, +30 magical armor; took 33,577 damage, mitigated 24,505, died 1 times.

Loadout augment Betrayer's Reqiuem: Kingslayer now launches every enemy near the first hero hit, not just one, and comes back sooner. Aim it into a grouped team for a group knock-up instead of a single pick. (game text: Kingslayer uppercuts all Enemies in an area around the initial Target. Additionally, Kingslayer's Cooldown is reduced by 15%.) (changes Kingslayer, 95.8s cooldown with their haste) Field: 50.1% in 882 games, 32% of picks, level the hero-role's 49.3%.

Loadout Eternal Thraex: Basic attacks mark his target: he deals more damage to them and takes less from them. Lock onto the enemy Skull Crusher hit and keep swinging. (game text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).) Field: 48.9% in 1177 games, 43% of picks, level the hero-role's 49.3%.

Loadout minor Alpha's Court: Bayle deals bonus damage when no ally is close by. Rewards solo dueling in a side lane or catching enemies alone. (game text: Deal 6% bonus damage when no allied hero is within 800 units.) Field: 49.4% in 861 games, 73% of picks, level the hero-role's 49.3%.

Loadout minor Ferocity: Attack speed keeps rising each second Bayle stays in a hero fight, so long fights favor Bayle more as they go. Weak in quick skirmishes. (game text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.) Field: 48.6% in 1110 games, 94% of picks, level the hero-role's 49.3%.

Loadout crest Judgement: Activate mid-fight to hit everyone around him and heal on each hero hit; the first heals fully, the rest at 50%. Use after Skull Crusher lands him in the crowd. (game text: Thunder Cleaver:  Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.) Field: 49.1% in 1586 games, 57% of picks, level the hero-role's 49.3%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Rapture, Fist Of Razuul, Cursed Scroll, Thraex.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Rapture, Fist Of Razuul, Judgement.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Aegis Of Agawar, Cursed Scroll. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Alpha's Court + Ferocity) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 2 of the 4 players Bayle killed built physical armor (Phase, Aurora). Anti-heal on Aurora. We killed Bayle 1 time.
Copy it? Thraex (Alpha's Court + Ferocity): 49% in 825 Bayle offlane games, level with the hero's 49.3%. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.
